title: 雅思·教育与学习精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 尽管学费被免除了，交通费仍可能让农村学生无法上大学。
items.en: Although tuition fees are waived, transport costs may still prevent rural students from attending university.
answers: Although tuition fees are waived, transport costs may still prevent rural students from attending university.
items.notes: although 引导让步；prevent sb from doing 表示阻止某人做事。用具体费用说明免费教育的局限。

items.zh: 与其按考试成绩奖励学校，不如考察学生取得了多大进步。
items.en: Rather than reward schools for exam results, authorities should assess how much progress their pupils have made.
answers: Rather than reward schools for exam results, authorities should assess how much progress their pupils have made.
items.notes: rather than 后接动词原形，与 should assess 平行；make progress 中 progress 不可数。

items.zh: 无法在家安静学习的孩子尤其能从课后学习空间中受益。
items.en: Children who cannot study quietly at home stand to benefit most from after-school study spaces.
answers: Children who cannot study quietly at home stand to benefit most from after-school study spaces.
items.notes: who 从句限定受益群体；stand to benefit 表示有望受益。

items.zh: 只有在教师有时间提供反馈时，减少班级人数才可能改善学习效果。
items.en: Only when teachers have time to give feedback is a reduction in class size likely to improve learning outcomes.
answers: Only when teachers have time to give feedback is a reduction in class size likely to improve learning outcomes.
items.notes: only when 置于句首，主句用部分倒装 is a reduction；避免把小班教学写成必然有效。

items.zh: 死记日期或许能帮助学生通过考试，却未必能让他们理解历史事件发生的原因。
items.en: Memorising dates may help students pass an exam without helping them understand why historical events occurred.
answers: Memorising dates may help students pass an exam without helping them understand why historical events occurred.
items.notes: without doing 突出手段的局限；why 引导宾语从句。

items.zh: 如果所有课程都转到线上，没有稳定网络的学生就会处于不利地位。
items.en: If all courses moved online, students without reliable internet access would be at a disadvantage.
answers: If all courses moved online, students without reliable internet access would be at a disadvantage.
items.notes: if + 过去式，主句 would + 动词，讨论假设；be at a disadvantage 表示处于不利地位。

items.zh: 职业培训能让人更快进入职场，而通识教育可能更有利于日后转行。
items.en: Vocational training can speed up entry into employment, whereas a broad education may make career changes easier later on.
answers: Vocational training can speed up entry into employment, whereas a broad education may make career changes easier later on.
items.notes: whereas 对比两种教育路径；may 保留适用范围，避免绝对判断。

items.zh: 奖学金应根据经济需要发放，而不应只奖励已经拥有充分支持的学生。
items.en: Scholarships should be awarded on the basis of financial need instead of merely rewarding students who already have ample support.
answers: Scholarships should be awarded on the basis of financial need instead of merely rewarding students who already have ample support.
items.notes: 被动语态聚焦奖学金；on the basis of 表示依据。

items.zh: 让学生解释自己如何得出答案，往往比再给他们一道相似的题更有价值。
items.en: Asking students to explain how they reached an answer is often more valuable than giving them another similar exercise.
answers: Asking students to explain how they reached an answer is often more valuable than giving them another similar exercise.
items.notes: 比较两项活动时使用平行的动名词 asking / giving；how 从句呈现思考过程。

items.zh: 没有教师培训，昂贵的新设备就可能只是闲置着。
items.en: Without teacher training, expensive new equipment may simply sit unused.
answers: Without teacher training, expensive new equipment may simply sit unused.
items.notes: without 指出配套条件缺失；sit unused 表示闲置，equipment 是不可数名词。

items.zh: 学校可以把图书馆开放到晚上，让白天工作的成年人也能使用。
items.en: Schools could keep their libraries open in the evening, allowing adults who work during the day to use them.
answers: Schools could keep their libraries open in the evening, allowing adults who work during the day to use them.
items.notes: keep + 宾语 + 形容词；allowing 短语说明措施带来的结果。

items.zh: 问题不在于是否布置作业，而在于每项任务是否有明确的学习目的。
items.en: The question is not whether homework should be set but whether each task serves a clear learning purpose.
answers: The question is not whether homework should be set but whether each task serves a clear learning purpose.
items.notes: not whether ... but whether ... 构成平行表语；serve a purpose 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 以为背熟范文就一定能提高写作能力，是一种误解。
items.en: It is a misconception that memorising model essays necessarily improves writing ability.
answers: It is a misconception that memorising model essays necessarily improves writing ability.
items.notes: it 为形式主语，that 从句说明误解的内容；necessarily 表示必然。

items.zh: 由于家长对课程改革了解不多，学校需要说明新方法将如何接受评估。
items.en: Because parents know little about the curriculum reform, schools need to explain how the new approach will be evaluated.
answers: Because parents know little about the curriculum reform, schools need to explain how the new approach will be evaluated.
items.notes: because 交代沟通需求的原因；how 从句使用将来时被动语态。

items.zh: 即使大学扩招，优质工作岗位的数量也不会自动增加。
items.en: Even if universities admit more students, the number of high-quality jobs will not automatically rise.
answers: Even if universities admit more students, the number of high-quality jobs will not automatically rise.
items.notes: even if 表示假设性让步；the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

items.zh: 一所只看升学率的学校可能忽略那些选择学徒培训的学生。
items.en: A school judged solely by university admission rates may neglect pupils who choose apprenticeships.
answers: A school judged solely by university admission rates may neglect pupils who choose apprenticeships.
items.notes: judged ... 是过去分词短语，修饰 school；solely 表示仅仅。

items.zh: 真正重要的是学生能否在陌生情境中运用所学知识。
items.en: What matters is whether students can apply what they have learned in unfamiliar situations.
answers: What matters is whether students can apply what they have learned in unfamiliar situations.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；whether 从句作表语，内部 what 从句作 apply 的宾语。

items.zh: 与一次考试相比，多次简短测验能更全面地反映学生的进步。
items.en: Compared with a single exam, several short assessments can provide a fuller picture of a student's progress.
answers: Compared with a single exam, several short assessments can provide a fuller picture of a student's progress.
items.notes: compared with 引出比较基准；provide a picture of 比喻呈现整体情况。

items.zh: 当学生可以质疑教材时，课堂讨论就不再只是复述事实。
items.en: When students are allowed to question a textbook, classroom discussion becomes more than a repetition of facts.
answers: When students are allowed to question a textbook, classroom discussion becomes more than a repetition of facts.
items.notes: be allowed to do 表示被允许；more than 表示超出某种局限。

items.zh: 教育预算有限，因此为每所学校购买相同的设备未必是最明智的选择。
items.en: Education budgets are limited; therefore, buying identical equipment for every school may not be the wisest choice.
answers: Education budgets are limited; therefore, buying identical equipment for every school may not be the wisest choice.
items.notes: therefore 是连接副词，此处用分号连接独立分句；避免逗号拼接。

items.zh: 如果一开始就咨询过教师，这次改革本可以避免一些实施上的问题。
items.en: Had teachers been consulted at the outset, the reform could have avoided some implementation problems.
answers: Had teachers been consulted at the outset, the reform could have avoided some implementation problems.
items.notes: had + 主语 + 过去分词是省略 if 的过去虚拟条件句；could have done 表示本可发生。

items.zh: 阅读课不仅应教授词汇，还应帮助学生识别作者的假设。
items.en: Reading lessons should teach vocabulary as well as help students identify an author's assumptions.
answers: Reading lessons should teach vocabulary as well as help students identify an author's assumptions.
items.notes: teach 与 help 是 should 后的平行动词；identify assumptions 表示识别隐含前提。

items.zh: 无论学生选择哪门专业，他们都需要学会评估证据。
items.en: Whichever subject students choose, they need to learn how to evaluate evidence.
answers: Whichever subject students choose, they need to learn how to evaluate evidence.
items.notes: whichever 引导让步从句；evidence 通常不可数。

items.zh: 为学生提供第二次提交作业的机会，可以把反馈变成实际改进。
items.en: Giving students a second chance to submit an assignment can turn feedback into tangible improvement.
answers: Giving students a second chance to submit an assignment can turn feedback into tangible improvement.
items.notes: give sb a chance to do；turn A into B 表示把反馈转化为改进。

items.zh: 在学前阶段，通过游戏探索世界可以帮助孩子把抽象词汇与亲身经历联系起来。
items.en: During the preschool years, exploring through play can help children connect abstract words with firsthand experiences.
answers: During the preschool years, exploring through play can help children connect abstract words with firsthand experiences.
items.notes: connect A with B：把两者联系起来。

items.zh: 孩子入学时的发展速度各不相同，因此统一的进度要求可能不适合所有人。
items.en: Children develop at different rates when they start school, so a uniform pace may not suit everyone.
answers: Children develop at different rates when they start school, so a uniform pace may not suit everyone.
items.notes: at different rates：以不同速度。

items.zh: 双语教学需要足够的语言支持，否则学生可能连学科内容也难以理解。
items.en: Bilingual teaching requires adequate language support; otherwise, students may struggle with the subject matter itself.
answers: Bilingual teaching requires adequate language support; otherwise, students may struggle with the subject matter itself.
items.notes: otherwise 前用分号连接完整分句。

items.zh: 母语受到尊重的学生，可能更愿意在课堂上分享家庭经历。
items.en: Students whose home languages are respected may feel more comfortable sharing their family experiences in class.
answers: Students whose home languages are respected may feel more comfortable sharing their family experiences in class.
items.notes: whose 引导所属关系的定语从句。

items.zh: 音乐课提供了合作演出的机会，这种体验很难通过独自刷题获得。
items.en: Music lessons offer opportunities to perform together, an experience that individual exercises can rarely provide.
answers: Music lessons offer opportunities to perform together, an experience that individual exercises can rarely provide.
items.notes: an experience 作同位语，概括前面的机会。

items.zh: 取消体育课来增加备考时间，可能牺牲学生每天活动的机会。
items.en: Replacing physical education with exam preparation may deprive pupils of a daily opportunity to be active.
answers: Replacing physical education with exam preparation may deprive pupils of a daily opportunity to be active.
items.notes: deprive sb of sth：使某人失去某物。

items.zh: 实验失败也能成为有价值的学习经历，只要学生被鼓励分析原因。
items.en: An unsuccessful experiment can still be a valuable learning experience if students are encouraged to analyse why it failed.
answers: An unsuccessful experiment can still be a valuable learning experience if students are encouraged to analyse why it failed.
items.notes: why 从句明确需要分析的内容。

items.zh: 实地考察让学生观察自然过程，而不是仅仅从课本中了解它们。
items.en: Field trips allow pupils to observe natural processes rather than merely read about them in textbooks.
answers: Field trips allow pupils to observe natural processes rather than merely read about them in textbooks.
items.notes: allow sb to do；observe 与 read 平行。

items.zh: 学校应教学生如何管理小额预算，因为许多人毕业后就要独立处理财务。
items.en: Schools should teach students how to manage a small budget, since many will handle their own finances after graduation.
answers: Schools should teach students how to manage a small budget, since many will handle their own finances after graduation.
items.notes: how to do 表达需要掌握的技能。

items.zh: 把编程设为必修课之前，应先明确它将挤占哪些课程的时间。
items.en: Before making coding compulsory, policymakers should identify which subjects would lose teaching time.
answers: Before making coding compulsory, policymakers should identify which subjects would lose teaching time.
items.notes: before doing 的主语与主句一致。

items.zh: 能够安静地读懂文章，并不意味着学生也能流利地口头表达。
items.en: Being able to understand a text silently does not imply an ability to express ideas fluently aloud.
answers: Being able to understand a text silently does not imply an ability to express ideas fluently aloud.
Being able to understand a text silently doesn't imply an ability to express ideas fluently aloud.
items.notes: does not imply：不能据此推断。

items.zh: 在同伴互评中，学生需要具体的标准，才能给出有帮助的建议。
items.en: Peer assessment requires clear criteria if students are to give useful advice.
answers: Peer assessment requires clear criteria if students are to give useful advice.
items.notes: if ... are to ...：若要实现某目标。

items.zh: 公开班级排名可能激励少数学生，却让长期落后的学生失去信心。
items.en: Publishing class rankings may motivate a few pupils while discouraging those who consistently fall behind.
answers: Publishing class rankings may motivate a few pupils while discouraging those who consistently fall behind.
items.notes: while doing 对照同一措施的两种影响。

items.zh: 对于考试焦虑严重的学生，熟悉考试流程可能比反复强调成绩更有帮助。
items.en: For students with severe test anxiety, familiarity with exam procedures may help more than repeated emphasis on scores.
answers: For students with severe test anxiety, familiarity with exam procedures may help more than repeated emphasis on scores.
items.notes: familiarity with：对某事的熟悉。

items.zh: 如果评分标准过于模糊，不同教师可能对同一份作业给出差异很大的分数。
items.en: Vague marking criteria can lead different teachers to assign widely different grades to the same assignment.
answers: Vague marking criteria can lead different teachers to assign widely different grades to the same assignment.
items.notes: lead sb to do：促使或导致某人做事。

items.zh: 允许开卷考试，并不消除设计有挑战性题目的必要。
items.en: Allowing open-book exams does not remove the need to design challenging questions.
answers: Allowing open-book exams does not remove the need to design challenging questions.
Allowing open-book exams doesn't remove the need to design challenging questions.
items.notes: the need to do：做某事的必要性。

items.zh: 小组作业只有在个人贡献可被识别时，才能得到更公平的评价。
items.en: Group assignments can be assessed more fairly when individual contributions are identifiable.
answers: Group assignments can be assessed more fairly when individual contributions are identifiable.
items.notes: be assessed：接受评价，强调评价对象。

items.zh: 作业截止时间若完全没有弹性，可能对承担照护责任的学生不利。
items.en: Completely inflexible deadlines may disadvantage students with caring responsibilities.
answers: Completely inflexible deadlines may disadvantage students with caring responsibilities.
items.notes: disadvantage 可用作及物动词。

items.zh: 教师花在行政表格上的时间越多，留给备课的时间就可能越少。
items.en: The more time teachers spend on administrative forms, the less they may have left for lesson preparation.
answers: The more time teachers spend on administrative forms, the less they may have left for lesson preparation.
items.notes: the more ... the less ... 表达此消彼长。

items.zh: 经验丰富的教师退休后，学校可能失去多年积累的教学经验。
items.en: When experienced teachers retire, schools may lose expertise accumulated over many years.
answers: When experienced teachers retire, schools may lose expertise accumulated over many years.
items.notes: accumulated 是修饰 expertise 的分词。

items.zh: 新教师若能定期观摩同事的课堂，就不必完全依靠试错来改进教学。
items.en: Regular opportunities to observe colleagues can help new teachers improve without relying entirely on trial and error.
answers: Regular opportunities to observe colleagues can help new teachers improve without relying entirely on trial and error.
items.notes: trial and error：反复试验和纠错。

items.zh: 提高教师工资或许有助于招聘，但也需要改善偏远学校的工作条件。
items.en: Higher salaries may help recruit teachers, but working conditions in remote schools also need improvement.
answers: Higher salaries may help recruit teachers, but working conditions in remote schools also need improvement.
items.notes: recruit：招募，区分招聘与留任条件。

items.zh: 当纪律处分让学生失去更多课堂时间时，学习差距可能进一步扩大。
items.en: Learning gaps may widen when disciplinary measures remove pupils from the classroom for longer periods.
answers: Learning gaps may widen when disciplinary measures remove pupils from the classroom for longer periods.
items.notes: widen 作不及物动词表示扩大。

items.zh: 处理校园欺凌需要安全的报告渠道，尤其是在受害者担心报复的时候。
items.en: Addressing school bullying requires safe reporting channels, particularly when victims fear retaliation.
answers: Addressing school bullying requires safe reporting channels, particularly when victims fear retaliation.
items.notes: particularly when 突出特定情境。

items.zh: 残障学生需要的支持可能包括无障碍材料，而不仅仅是额外的考试时间。
items.en: Support for students with disabilities may include accessible materials, not merely extra examination time.
answers: Support for students with disabilities may include accessible materials, not merely extra examination time.
items.notes: not merely：补充被忽视的需求。

items.zh: 阅读困难不应被简单地理解为缺乏努力。
items.en: Difficulty with reading should not automatically be interpreted as a lack of effort.
answers: Difficulty with reading should not automatically be interpreted as a lack of effort.
items.notes: interpret A as B：把 A 理解为 B。

items.zh: 学校护士能在健康问题妨碍学习之前，帮助学生得到适当的照护。
items.en: School nurses can help pupils obtain appropriate care before health problems interfere with learning.
answers: School nurses can help pupils obtain appropriate care before health problems interfere with learning.
items.notes: interfere with：妨碍。

items.zh: 寄宿生活可能培养独立性，也可能让年幼的孩子感到与家人疏远。
items.en: Boarding school may foster independence while leaving younger children feeling distant from their families.
answers: Boarding school may foster independence while leaving younger children feeling distant from their families.
items.notes: leave sb feeling ...：使人产生某种感受。

items.zh: 在家上学的质量很大程度上取决于家庭能够提供的时间和资源。
items.en: The quality of home education depends heavily on the time and resources a family can provide.
answers: The quality of home education depends heavily on the time and resources a family can provide.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的从句修饰并列名词。

items.zh: 当家长工作时间不固定时，固定在下午举行的家长会可能让他们难以参加。
items.en: Parents with unpredictable working hours may struggle to attend meetings held at a fixed time in the afternoon.
answers: Parents with unpredictable working hours may struggle to attend meetings held at a fixed time in the afternoon.
items.notes: held 是修饰 meetings 的过去分词。

items.zh: 大学录取若考虑申请者的成长环境，就能更全面地理解他们取得的成绩。
items.en: Considering applicants' backgrounds can give universities a fuller understanding of their achievements.
answers: Considering applicants' backgrounds can give universities a fuller understanding of their achievements.
items.notes: a fuller understanding of：更全面的理解。

items.zh: 学生贷款的还款压力可能影响毕业生是否愿意从事收入较低的公共服务工作。
items.en: Student loan repayments may influence whether graduates pursue lower-paid public service careers.
answers: Student loan repayments may influence whether graduates pursue lower-paid public service careers.
items.notes: whether 引导选择性的宾语从句。

items.zh: 国际学生既带来收入，也为课堂讨论提供不同的生活经验。
items.en: International students contribute revenue as well as diverse lived experiences to classroom discussion.
answers: International students contribute revenue as well as diverse lived experiences to classroom discussion.
items.notes: contribute A to B；as well as 补充另一贡献。

items.zh: 实习只有在学生获得指导时，才不至于沦为廉价劳动力的来源。
items.en: Internships need proper supervision if they are not to become a source of cheap labour.
answers: Internships need proper supervision if they are not to become a source of cheap labour.
Internships need proper supervision if they aren't to become a source of cheap labour.
items.notes: if ... are not to ...：为避免某结果。

items.zh: 大学与企业合作时，需要保护研究人员发表不受欢迎结果的自由。
items.en: University partnerships with businesses must protect researchers' freedom to publish unwelcome findings.
answers: University partnerships with businesses must protect researchers' freedom to publish unwelcome findings.
items.notes: freedom to do：做某事的自由。

items.zh: 并非所有有价值的研究都能在短期内产生商业回报。
items.en: Not all worthwhile research produces commercial returns in the short term.
answers: Not all worthwhile research produces commercial returns in the short term.
items.notes: not all 为部分否定，不等于全盘否定。

items.zh: 成年学习者常常把工作经验带进课堂，使理论讨论更贴近实际。
items.en: Adult learners often bring professional experience into the classroom, making theoretical discussions more practical.
answers: Adult learners often bring professional experience into the classroom, making theoretical discussions more practical.
items.notes: making 表示前面行为带来的结果。

items.zh: 短期证书课程是否有用，取决于雇主是否认可其教授的技能。
items.en: The value of a short certificate course depends on whether employers recognise the skills it teaches.
answers: The value of a short certificate course depends on whether employers recognise the skills it teaches.
items.notes: whether 从句作介词 on 的宾语。

items.zh: 如果教育政策每几年就彻底改变，学校可能难以评估长期效果。
items.en: Frequent overhauls of education policy can make long-term evaluation difficult for schools.
answers: Frequent overhauls of education policy can make long-term evaluation difficult for schools.
items.notes: make + 宾语 + 形容词。

items.zh: 教育的收益有些要多年后才会显现，因此短期就业率只能提供部分信息。
items.en: Some benefits of education emerge only after many years, so short-term employment rates tell only part of the story.
answers: Some benefits of education emerge only after many years, so short-term employment rates tell only part of the story.
items.notes: tell part of the story：仅反映部分情况。
